fields.title: Keyword suggestion record
fields.description: One row per unique keyword harvested from Blibli's search box. IMPORTANT: Blibli publishes no search volume - every volume-shaped field in its autocomplete payload is null - so this actor reports no volume figure. `competingProducts` (how many products Blibli returns for the keyword) and `suggestPosition` (rank in Blibli's own suggestion ordering) are the measured signals provided instead. Every type is nullable because which fields are populated depends on the source and on whether competition measurement was enabled.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The seed keyword that produced this row; empty for trending and curated rows.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: autocomplete, autocomplete-expansion, related-search, trending, curated, or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this keyword was harvested.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_INPUT, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: The suggestion exactly as Blibli's search box offers it - what shoppers actually type.

seedKeyword.title: Seed
seedKeyword.description: The seed this keyword was expanded from.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the keyword came from: autocomplete (bare seed), autocomplete-expansion (seed + a suffix), related-search, trending or curated.

sourcePrefix.title: Source prefix
sourcePrefix.description: The exact prefix typed to surface this keyword, e.g. 'laptop g'. Null when it came from the bare seed.

suggestPosition.title: Suggestion rank
suggestPosition.description: 1-based position within Blibli's own autocomplete ordering for that prefix, produced by their relevance model. An ordinal popularity signal - NOT a search volume, which Blibli does not publish.

competingProducts.title: Competing products
competingProducts.description: How many products Blibli actually returns for this keyword - measured, not estimated. The practical difficulty signal: 'laptop' returns 58,744 while 'laptop gaming' returns 6,639. Null when competition measurement is disabled.

competitionLevel.title: Competition level
competitionLevel.description: Readability band over competingProducts: LOW (<1k), MEDIUM (<10k), HIGH (<50k), VERY_HIGH. A convenience label from this actor, not a Blibli metric - the raw count is always alongside.

characterCount.title: Character count
characterCount.description: Length of the keyword, useful when fitting terms into a product title.

isLongTail.title: Long tail
isLongTail.description: True for keywords of 3+ words - typically easier to rank for and higher-converting.

containsSeed.title: Contains seed
containsSeed.description: Whether the keyword literally contains the seed. False rows are lateral discoveries, e.g. 'tas laptop jinjing' from the seed 'laptop'.

searchUrl.title: Search URL
searchUrl.description: Blibli search results page for this keyword.

promoUrl.title: Promo URL
promoUrl.description: Curated rows only. The promo page the curated keyword links to.
